subject: english
stem: A park has no benches now, but it had six last year. Which sentence reports the change?
options: There be benches before and no now.
There are no benches now, but there were six last year.
There is no benches now, but there was six last year.
There were no benches now, but there are six last year.

optionRationales.reason: There be benches before and no now.：缺少時態與完整結構。
There are no benches now, but there were six last year.：現在複數否定與過去複數分別用 are、were。
There is no benches now, but there was six last year.：兩個複數都誤用單數 be。
There were no benches now, but there are six last year.：時態顛倒。

provenance.copyrightStatus: Original wording; official sources used only for scope and assessment calibration.

independentReviews.evidence: 先遮住選項，依「依存在物核心名詞的數與事件時間，選擇 there is/are 或 there was/were，並在多項清單中保持資訊精確。」可推出 There are no benches now, but there were six last year.；再核對題面每個線索，答案索引一致。
把四個選項逐一代回原文，只有 There are no benches now, but there were six last year. 能同時滿足句法與全文意思；另外三項各有明確衝突，沒有第二答案。
